question: At the campaign's 12-circuit decision scale, what is the gate's fidelity-component pass probability - P(mean delta > min_delta AND CI excludes 0), the two components the campaign gate evaluates on measurement data; the cost gate (wall-time ratio <= 1.02) is deterministic per config here and is NOT simulated - for a true effect of the size the campaign actually saw, and what is same-config run-to-run noise?
motivation: Round 1 ran the same mutation (chi_alloc easy32hard128) in both arms: flywheel delta +0.0336 CI [-0.0013,+0.0737] REJECTED, control delta +0.0344 CI [+0.0010,+0.0744] PROMOTED - the gate verdict flipped on CI noise at n=12.
no_contact_clause: EXP-008 never reads, imports or derives from prototype/suite/ or any holdout artifact. Circuits are FRESH: generated from EXP008_SEED=20261007, with an import-time assertion (ast parse of src/freeze_suite.py) that EXP008_SEED is not among its integer seed literals (SPLIT_SEED=20261107, R_BASE_SEED=20261100) and that the 48 derived EXP-008 seeds are disjoint from the 48 derived suite seeds. The only suite-related read is the src/freeze_suite.py SOURCE for that assertion (not a suite artifact). Path arguments resolving inside suite/ or a holdout dir are refused by code in every subcommand.

circuits.per_circuit_seed: EXP008_SEED + n*100 + d*10 + i (same arithmetic shape as freeze_suite.py:86)
circuits.generator: circuits.rcs_circuit - mirrors src/freeze_suite.py RCS brickwork, fresh seeds
circuits.truth: local qiskit statevector probabilities, float32 .npy (sim_exact.save_probabilities - same method as the suite build)

configs.easy_hard_rule_provenance: src/harness.py:52,150-152 (easy: d<=8, hard: d>=12); shots rule src/harness.py:63,155-157 (uniform20k = 20000 both classes); no permutation in either config

design.idempotency_key: job-name string (deterministic across runs); dispatch-once contract: a name with ANY provider row in jobs.sqlite is never re-dispatched (resume = collect by provider id); after each group dispatch asserts name<->provider-id uniqueness (exactly one id per name, no id shared across names); within a live run_batch, bq's batch-level reservation key + 120-min same-name adoption window cover process kills; a terminal-failed job is recorded with its error and never resubmitted (experiment then incomplete by prereg)

dispatch_guards: 1. ledger/experiments.json must show EXP-008-GATE-CALIBRATION state REGISTERED (refuse otherwise - expected during review)
1b. on-disk SPEC.md and PREREGISTRATION.json sha256 must match the registration pins in ledger/experiments.json (refuse on drift - post-registration edits de-register the prereg)
2. daily cap: today's mps.cpu+pauli-path rows in ledger/jobs.sqlite (column submitted_at, UTC date) + remaining plan jobs must be <= 900, else refuse until after 00:00 UTC

3. refuse any path argument resolving inside suite/ or a holdout dir; plan artifact paths must be relative, contained in the data dir after resolve() and realpath() (no symlink escape), and never inside suite/holdout
4. account guard: BQ_ACCOUNT must be unset or 'test' (TEST account only)
5. dispatch and analyze recompute every qpy/truth sha256 against the plan pins and check truth shape (float32, length 2^n) before any cloud call or scoring

scoring.xeb: metrics.xeb_normalized(metrics.canonical_counts(counts, 'mps.cpu'), truth_npy) - canonical bit order un-reverses mps keys
scoring.counts_validation: before scoring: provider_job_id present + matching the ledger row for that name, run_status COMPLETED, counts sum == 20000, bitstring width == n, 192 distinct provider ids across 192 jobs; any violation = SystemExit (no partial analysis)
scoring.failure_policy: missing counts / non-COMPLETED / provenance mismatch -> SystemExit, never defaults
scoring.once_only: analyze records an inputs digest (plan.json + all counts blobs); an existing analysis.json is never overwritten unless the digest is unchanged AND --redo is passed; a digest mismatch is always refused

A1.how: per rep (2 x 48 values) and pooled per circuit over the 2 reps (48 values); pooled value = mean of the two per-rep deltas

A2.what: bootstrap 95% CI of the pooled mean
A2.how: percentile method over the 48 pooled deltas
A2.rng: numpy default_rng(11), one integers(0,48,size=(10000,48)) draw, means along axis 1
A2.note: 10000 is an EXP-008 choice, larger than the campaign decision bootstrap's 5000 (src/metrics.py:128 paired_delta, seed 3)

A3.how: per circuit |rep1 - rep2| of the per-circuit XEB, per config; report mean and sd (ddof=1) of that quantity per config, plus mean/min_delta ratios

A4.what: fidelity-component pass-probability simulation at the n=12 decision scale
A4.cost_gate: the campaign cost gate (wall-time ratio <= 1.02) is NOT simulated - EXP-008 per-config cost is deterministic
A4.scope: the fresh library includes n=22 circuits (absent from the frozen suite); subset draws model circuit-subset choice, not fresh shot noise
A4.subset_rule: 12 of 48 circuits per draw, without replacement, numpy default_rng(12)
gate_components: mean of the 12 drawn pooled deltas > min_delta (0.026951928377626822)
percentile-bootstrap 95% CI over the 12 drawn circuits excludes 0, rule ci_low > 0 (campaign semantics, src/metrics.py:146)

inner_bootstrap.rng: numpy default_rng(13), fresh stream per effect level, one integers(0,12,size=(2000,12)) draw per subset

levels: (b) shifted by (min_delta - observed_pooled_mean) so the true mean sits exactly at min_delta
A4.A4b: same subset draws on the two per-rep single-evaluation libraries (rep1, rep2; 48 deltas each, same circuit subsets); the pooled two-rep library and the per-rep libraries bracket the campaign's single-evaluation decision
A4.reported: P(mean>min_delta), P(CI excludes 0), P(both)=fidelity-component pass probability, per level, pooled and per-rep (A4b)
A4.deviation: inner bootstrap uses 2000 resamples, not the campaign decision bootstrap's 5000 (src/metrics.py:128, seed 3): 10000 draws x 5000 resamples x 12 circuits was the nesting feasibility bound; the inner rng(13) stream advances across draws within each effect level (fresh stream per level) - an approximation of the campaign's fresh-per-decision rng

A5.what: frozen prediction, scored once by analyze
A5.score: in_band = band_low <= observed <= band_high, reported in data/analysis.json and ANALYSIS.md

prediction.metric: pooled mean per-circuit paired delta (challenger easy32hard128 - baseline uniform64, 48 fresh circuits)
prediction.rationale: chi telemetry (EXP-004) showed hard circuits chi-starved at 64 and easy circuits chi-saturated; shifting chi 64->128 on d>=12 should recover a large fraction of their truncation loss while 32 on d<=8 costs little; band widened for circuit-fresh sampling and MPS-device noise
